extDescription.message: Send any web video to Apple TV / AirPlay in full quality — just the player, not the whole screen. Unblocks AirPlay on players that disable it and finds the real HLS/MP4 stream behind MSE players.

actionFullscreen.message: Open in native player (AirPlay button inside)

actionOpenTab.message: Open stream in a new tab

statusNoApi.message: This browser has no AirPlay API (use Safari on iPhone/iPad/Mac)

sourceDirectBlob.message: Player uses MSE (blob:) — needs the real stream URL

kindDash.message: DASH manifest — not playable by AirPlay (Safari has no native DASH)

kindSegment.message: Media segment — not a full stream

noStreams.message: No AirPlay-compatible stream found yet. Press play on the video for a few seconds and reopen this panel.

drmHint.message: If this is a DRM-protected service (Netflix, Disney+, …), AirPlay of the stream is impossible from a browser.

proxyHint.message: This mini player drives the AirPlay session. Close it to return to the page player.

popupNoVideos.message: No videos detected on this page.

popupNoTab.message: Open a page with a video and try again.

popupIosHint.message: On iPhone/iPad Safari only allows the AirPlay picker from a tap inside the page: tap the blue AirPlay badge on the video.

popupAutoUnblock.message: Automatically unblock AirPlay on page players

popupPauseOriginal.message: Pause the page player while AirPlaying

popupHookOff.message: Deep stream capture: unavailable in this Safari (basic capture still works)
